name: storymotion
description: Websites with the right amount of story and motion: narrative levels, beat sheets, motion rules, copy-ready recipes (pinned scenes, themed scroll gauges, loaders, page transitions, i18n) and React/Next/Astro notes.

interface.shortDescription: Websites with the right amount of story and motion
interface.longDescription: Decides whether a site needs a story (full, one scene, or none), writes the beat sheet, and builds loaders, scroll gauges and page transitions in the same story with copy-ready recipes and a small runtime.
defaultPrompt: Build a landing page for my bakery that tells a story as you scroll.
